scoring_justification: The magnetization MAE is recomputed from the submitted CSV against the exact Onsager formula; the critical temperatures are compared directly to the paper's reported SFA values. Both are deterministic numeric checks.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference gold values for SFA critical temperatures from the paper
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text: Section 3 states Tc/J=2.4743 for 2D square lattice; Section 4 table gives Tc/J=2.0243 for 3D simple cubic lattice (z=6).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Direct extraction of the publicly reported numbers in the paper's text and table.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the published SFA predictions for the specified lattices, used as the hidden target to verify correct implementation of the SFA method.

outputs.description: Magnetization μ as a function of reduced temperature X=T/J for the 2D square-lattice Ising model in SFA.

schema.description: First line: critical temperature for 2D square lattice (float), second line: critical temperature for 3D simple cubic lattice (float).

outputs.description: Critical temperatures X_c = T_c/J for the 2D and 3D Ising models in the SFA.
